Earnest Money Deposit: Bidders shall upload EMD particulars or exemp tion document s in the relevant section of GeM while quoting the bid. Pleas e refer clause (a) of the bid doc ument, clause 4 sub clause XIII (m) and cla use 2(k) of General Terms and Conditions on Ge M hyperlinked with the bid document for further details on Earnest Money Deposit. The EM D shall be submitted in Sealed Envelope with GeM bid number and date, Firm's compl ete a ddress to Dy Chief Material Manager /G, Principal Chief Material Mana ger Office, 6th Floor, Rail Nilayam, Secunderabad, Telangana- 500003. 3. Security Deposit/ePBG Details: The applicable ePBG is 5% of Contract value for the period mentioned in Bid document. Security Deposit will be valid for 2 months beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligati ons. a. Security deposit/ePBG has to be deposited after award of GeM contract i n acceptable money instruments specified in Clause 2 (l) and Clause 7 of G eM GTC attached with bid. b. If Bidder fails to deposit ePBG within stipulated time frame and condition as specified in GeM GTC then contract may be cancelled by the buyer and Purchaser shall have right to levy damages from the supplier for failing to c omply with contractual conditions, not by way of penalty, an amount equal to SD amount, as would have been submitted. These damages shall be tre ated as recoveries outstanding aga inst the Seller and shall be dealt with a ccordingly.

c. In addition to above, Buyer shall raise an incident through the incident management system of GeM against failure of submission of ePBG ,for initi ating stern action of Banning /Suspension as per clause 21 (ii) sub clause ( g) of GeM GTC. d. Seller's failure to submit Performance guarantee shall be treated as bad performance an d will be dealt accordingly. e. Money Instrument shall be pledged in the name of PFA/SCR. [Proforma as per Annexure-B of Buyer uploaded ATC document] 4. Eligibility Criteria: The clauses mentioned in this section shall be mandatory for all the bidder s. In case of failure of the bidder to submit the documents sought in these clauses , their offer shall be summarily rejected and will not be considered at the time of representation. [A] AVAILABILITY OF PRINTING PRESS OF SERVICE PROVIDER: Service Provider should have Printing Press , Designer as well as Binding fa cility for proper coordination, inputs for content and designing, proof readin gs and final approvals. They shall upload declaration of installed printing Machines and Fac ilities available in the format specified in Annexure-A on buyer uploaded AT C . [Proforma as per Annexure-A of Buyer uploaded ATC document] [B] Past Performance: (i) The tenderer with past performance of satisfactory execution of contract s to SC Railway, or Other Zonal Railways/ PUs for supply of the Same / Simi lar Item ( i.e. A3/A4/A5/A6 size printed pages/forms/sheets etc) for a quanti ty of 20 percent or more of tendered quantity against a single contract dur ing last three Financial years prior to, and excluding tender opening date may be considered as responsive to SC Railways requirements for placeme nt of bulk and regular order. Tenderers are requested to submit the past pe rformance report i.e. Copies of R Notes/CRAC/CRN/Proof of acceptance of material by consignee along with their offer; failing which offer will be sum marily rejected without making any back reference. Note: Number of pages shall be calculated as per Proof of Supply submitted by the bidder indicatin g number of books/booklet and number of pages in each book / booklet. The threshold quantity for supply performance in any one single contract shall be of 1,51,60,000 Book-pages / Form-pages or both .

Note: Number of pages shall be calculated as per experience certificate/Pr oof of Supply submitted by the bidder indicating number of books/booklet and number of pages in each book /booklet (ii) Only OEMs or their authorized dealers are eligible to participate in the t ender. In case, the tenderer participates as an authorized dealer, then the performance as required above shall be that of Principal (OEM) authorizing the agent or bidder for the same OEM. It may so happen that the agent/de aler has credentials of past supply for a different Principal/OEM, then it will not be Considered as performance. For Authorised dealers, tender specific authorization from OEM has to be uploaded with bid. [C] The bidder shall give full details of the constitution of the Firm/ Company/Society etc. and shall also submit following documents (as app licable), in addition to documents mentioned above: (a) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit the notarized co py of the affidavit or GST certificate which indicates proprietorship st atus . (b) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of (i ) registered/notarized Partnership Deed and (ii) Power of Attorney dul y authorizing one or more of the partners of the firm or any other per sons(s), authorized by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreement, witness measurements , sign Measurement Books, receive payment, make correspondences, compromise/settle/ relinquish any claim (s) preferred by the firm, sig n 'No Claim certificate', refer all or any dispute to arbitration and to ta ke similar action in respect of all Bids/contracts OR said Bid/contract. (c) Company registered under Companies Act-1956: The Bidder shall submit (i) the copies of MOA (Memorandum of Association) and AOA ( Articles of Association) of the Company; and (ii) Power of Attorney dul y registered/notarized by the company (backed by the resolution of B oard of Directors) in favour of the individual, signing the Bid on behalf of the Company. (d) Society: The bidder shall submit (i) Self- attested copy of the certif icate of Registration, (ii) Deed of Formation and (iii) Power of Attorne y in favour of the tender signatory

(e) Joint Venture (JV): Joint Venture (JV) not permitted. 5. GST : Please refer to Clause 8 of GeM GTC hyperlinked with the bid docu ment . Buyer sh all raise invoice for S.C. Railway (Telangana) GST No.: 36A AAGM0289C1ZK for Telangana based consignee and S.C. Railway (AP) GST No.: 37AAAGM0289C1ZI for Andhra Pradesh based Consignee. 6. Delivery Period and Extension Of Delivery : The Service Provider has t o print and deliver to the Consignee indicated in the Bid . Time is the essen ce of this Contract. Please refer to Clause 15 of GeM GTC hyperlinked with bid . Bidder shall adhere to the timeline mentioned in bid / contract for sup ply of goods . These are for Railway Internal working and for passengers, so it should be supplied as soon as possible. Any delay beyond 10 days sh all attract Liquidated Damages penalty of 0.5% per week. Delivery to Commence within 10 days after issue of Contract and to be Co mpleted within 03 months thereafter. The items should be delivered within 05 days from the date of approval of Sample. The Consignee shall mention the date of sample approval and date of supply invariably in the Receipt N ote. Delivery Location: Office of Dy.CMM/G&S/MFT, Mettuguda, Secunderabad 7. Failure of Contract & Recoverable Damages : If the Seller fails to suppl y goods as p er GeM contract within Delivery period or extended delivery p eriod or at any time repudiates the contract before the expiry of delivery p eriod, Buyer reserves the right to cancel the GeM contract for unsupplied p ortion , record adverse performance of the bidder for taking appropriate ad ministrative action. (a) through incident Management of GeM. (b) rejection of offer on account of bad performance in ensuing bids i nvited by buyer. (c) forfeit the security deposit( ePBG) or initiate recoveries outstandin g for an amount equivalent to applicable Security Deposit for undeliv ered portion. (d) In severable contracts, in case of failure by the seller to meet deli veries for any lot, Railways may cancel the contract for defaulted part by forfeiting SD commensurate with that lot or initiating recoveries fo r an amount equivalent to Security Deposit /ePBG for undelivered por tion.

8. Arbitration Clause : The GeM contract will be governed by the arbitratio n clause, as per Para 2900: SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTES in Annexure-A of Ra ilway boar d letter No. 2018/TF/Civil/Arbitration Policy dated 12.12.2018 (copy of which is enclosed with the bid in the "Buyer uploaded ATC docume nt"). This is in supersession to the "Arbitration Clause" mentioned in the "Bi d Details". 9.Sample approval: The service provider shall get the sample approved be fore bulk printing of the forms against the requirement communicated by C onsignee (Soft copies of the Forms shall be provided by the Consignee. Any changes suggested by the consignee shall be carried out before Sample Ap proval . The Supplier/firm shall submit two (02) advance samples to the Co nsignee for the purpose of proof-reading and assessment of quality parame ters, including paper quality, printing, numbering, layout, and overall finish . Upon receipt of the advance samples, the Consignee shall examine them i n accordance with the framework of contract specifications and shall, withi n five (05) working days, either approve the samples or provide a compreh ensive list of required modifications. It shall be the responsibility of the sup plier to ensure that the bulk supply strictly conforms to the approved samp le, including all modifications as communicated by the Consignee. In the ev ent that the submitted sample is found to have major deviations or fails to conform to the contract specifications, the Consignee/Buyer, at its sole disc retion, may call for fresh samples for re-approval prior to authorizing bulk s upplies. Alternatively, the Buyer may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the supplier and may forfeit the Security Deposit (SD) or r ecover an equivalent amount in cases where SD is exempted. Unless other wise provided in the contract, all samples required for inspection and testin g shall be supplied by the Supplier/ firm at no additional cost to the Buyer. Furthermore, any expenditure incurred by the Supplier/ firm on or in conne ction with the bulk production of material prior to unconditional approval of the advance sample shall be borne entirely by the supplier, and no claim fo r compensation shall be entertained by the Buyer or the Consignee in the e vent of rejection of the sample. 10. Packing : Forms shall be bundled in suitable denomination as per abov e table. The printed items shall be securely packed in suitable-size, five-ply corrugated paperboard cartons, conforming to IS: 2771 (Part-1):1990 with Amendments No. 1 and 2, or the latest applicable version, and designed as per Style 0620 of IS: 6481:1971, or its latest revision. Each carton shall be sealed with gum paper tape of minimum 50 mm width, followed by strappi ng with two nylon straps of 13 mm width each, applied on all sides. The en ds of the nylon straps shall be heat-sealed with an overlap of not less than 25 mm to ensure tamper-proof packaging. A packing slip must be firmly aff ixed on each carton, clearly indicating, (a) Form Name and PL Number, (b) Short Description of Items, (c) Quantity Contained, (d) Date of Dispatch, (e) Purchase Order Number and Date, and (f) Name of the Supplying Firm.

11. Transportation: The firm shall arrange to transport safely the printed i tems in aforesaid packing condition to the Consignee on their own cost and transport arrangement. 12. Inspection by consignee against approved sample: The supplies shal l be subject to inspection by the Consignee at the time of receipt, and the a cceptance shall be based on conformity to the approved sample submitted by the successful bidder. Supplies not matching the approved sample in qu ality, specification, or workmanship may be rejected at the discretion of the consignee. 13.Removal of Rejected Goods : Bidders shall refer Clause 11(iv) of GeM GTC hyperlinked with bid. No payment shall be made for rejected goods or services. After intimation of the rejection / part rejection by the Buyer/ Con signee, the Seller shall be liable to remove / lift back such rejected Goods w ithin 10 days without any extra charge/cost to the Buyer / Consignee failing which suitable ground rent / warehousing charges would be payable by the Seller to the Buyer/Consignee. If the Seller fails to remove / lift back such re jected Goods within reasonable time period, the Buyer / Consignee shall ha ve the right to dispose off such rejected goods at the risk and cost of the se ller. 14.Payment: Payment shall be made on actual basis . The Service Delivery Acceptance will be generated by consignee in the respective schedule of G eM Contract and R Note in IMMS against PL of respective schedule against t he coverage PO . The bill shall be forwarded in FA & CAO/S&W/SC in GeM module . 15. Post tender opening no new documents(which are not part of original b id offer uploaded by service provider before opening of GeM bid ) will be co nsidered for bid evaluation. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don 't upload any of the certificates /documents sought in the Specification , Bi d document, Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms and Conditions an d Corrigendum if any. 16. This tender is governed by Gem SLA, GTC of GeM, Scope of work in whi ch special conditions are defined. Situation whenever relevant rules/guideli nes/clauses are not available in bid conditions, the relevant clause/paras of General conditions of contract for services will be applicable. GCC for servi ces 2018 and its amendments (up to tender opening date)are available on the Railway board website. The Hyperlink for GCC for services in Railway is as following

https://indianrailways.gov.in/railwayboard/uploads/directorate/Transformation_Cell/General%2 0Conditions%20of%20Contract%20for%20Services.pdf 17. Mandatory Documents to be uploaded with offer: a) EMD or EMD Exemption document in the relevant section of GeM. b) Printing Press details as specified in clause (4[A]) of Buyer Added Bid S pecific ATC as per Annexure - A uploaded in Buyer uploaded ATC docume nt. c) Past performance documents as specified in clause (4[B]) of Buyer Add ed Bid Specific ATC. d) Constitution of firm details as specified in clause (4[C]) of Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC. e)Local content percentage with address of local content addition . 3.
